t: This is Denmark Street, a short street on the edge of the West End, running from Charing Cross Road to St Giles High Street. It was developed in the late seventeenth century and named after Prince George of Denmark, husband of Queen Anne, who reigned from 1702. Since the 1950s the street has been tied to British popular music, first through publishers, then recording studios and music shops. A blue plaque, unveiled in 2014, marks its importance to the music industry.
